title: An authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway versions earlier than 9.4.0.030 allows an unauthenticated…
description: An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in Barracuda Email Security Gateway versions earlier than 9.4.0.030. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted backup archive, leading to unauthorized modification of the appliance's global configuration.
